image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a car wheel mounted on a vehicle. The wheel features a complex multi-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (polished silver faces and black recessed areas). A black rubber tire surrounds the rim. The center cap displays a logo resembling the Mitsubishi three-diamond emblem. The wheel is resting on green grass, suggesting an outdoor setting. There are visible text artifacts on the lower tire sidewall.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is white text on the bottom of the tire that reads like 'AUTOWORLD' or similar nonsensical branding. Real tires have standardized alphanumeric codes (DOT, size), not stylized brand names in this font style. This is a common AI hallucination.
The edges of the silver spokes show slight softness and 'bleeding' into the black recesses, lacking the sharp, machined precision of real alloy wheels. The center logo is slightly distorted/melted.
The area where lug nuts should be is ambiguous. It appears as a smooth black void or a fused mass rather than distinct bolts or holes, suggesting structural vagueness.
